name: Pinball Arcade: TX-Sector
storyline: TX Sector (1988) is a highly collectible table from Gottlieb designed by John Trudeau, Constantino Mitchell, and Jeanine Mitchell. The backbox features a combination of hand drawn art and photography as well as a scoreboard that is positioned over the backglass to increase its visibility to others. The playfield shows off strikingly lit ramps and a curving plunger habitrail for exciting gameplay. Using staged captive balls, the game teleports balls across the table during gameplay for added attraction. 2,336 units of this table were produced.
